QUOTE: Two SSL test programs. `programs/ssl/ssl_server2.c:8` and `programs/ssl/ssl_client2.c:8` define the opt-out before including `ssl_test_lib.h`. They can therefore read and write internals directly.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that example programs under programs/ssl define MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS themselves and so reach past the public API into internals, as a deliberate coupling.
